answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9640 Country: India Title: I Have a dental problem: My teeth are very sensitive and hence i cannot drink water (especiall any thing cold). In this regard can i do a enamel filling on most of my teeth and also is it valid to use a permanent fixing of a tooth? (Where it is fixed permanenty and cannot be removed during wazu or Qusul). Question: As'salmu alaikum Wa rahmathulla... I Have a dental problem: My teeth are very sensitive and hence i cannot drink water (especiall any thing cold). In this regard can i do a enamel filling on most of my teeth and also is it valid to use a permanent fixing of a tooth? (Where it is fixed permanenty and cannot be removed during wazu or Qusul). Answer ID: 9640 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2285/2080=D/1429) Yes, one can fill gold or silver in teeth and this can be permanently fixed also. There is no need to remove it during wudhu and ghusl . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
